meta.title: SENDGUARD S00 outside referee - Windows file-name behaviour measured by the machine tools themselves
meta.method: Reserved+illegal+trailing create attempts run inside Start-Job child processes with an externally enforced 8s timeout (a device-open that blocks can never hang the controller). Listing via Get-ChildItem, cmd dir, System.IO.Directory and python os (NTFS wide enumeration). All non-ASCII names built from explicit code points so the typed name is unambiguous. On-disk names reported as UTF-16LE hex, not as typed. Zip bit-11 and stored name bytes parsed from the archive header bytes.
meta.safety: No file named with a reserved device name was ever opened or read. Creation of every reserved name via a normal path failed, so no device-named file existed to open, and no timeout/hang outcome was needed. Nothing from items 1-3 was deleted; the scratch directory is left in place, including stray files cmd produced from its quote/colon parsing.
